info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Refund Submission API
info.description: The Refund Submission API enables businesses to submit refund requests for processing. It focuses on ensuring timely and accurate handling of refund transactions, thereby enhancing customer satisfaction. Organizations can utilize this API for managing refund workflows and integrating these processes into their financial systems. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial service providers who need a streamlined solution for refund management.

post.summary: Submit a refund for a specific reservation
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a refund request for the reservation identified by its unique ID. Ensure that all required parameters are provided and valid before submitting the request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a refund for the specified refund ID. The payload must include the necessary details to process the refund successfully.
